audio.t: Has the deadline for the startup competition been extended?

questions.explain: 問題問截止日期是否延長，B 直接回答「是，延到下週五」。A 重複 start 字根但答非所問；C 的 line 與 deadline 音近，屬干擾選項。
options: We started our company last year.
Yes, teams now have until next Friday.
The line outside was really long.

audio.t: Who's going to pitch our idea to the judges?

questions.explain: Who 問句要回答「人」，C 指出由 Maya 上台提案最合理。A 的 pitch 是「投球」之意，屬一字多義陷阱；B 重複 judges 但說的是位置。
options: Throw the pitch a little higher.
The judges sat near the stage.
I think Maya should, since she's our strongest speaker.

audio.t: I'm not sure our prototype will be ready in time.

questions.explain: 對方擔心原型來不及完成，A 提出向創客空間申請延長使用時間的解決辦法。B 重複 time；C 的 type 與 prototype 音近，皆不相關。
options: Why don't we ask the makerspace for extra hours?
It's about time for lunch.
That type of paper is wrong.

audio.t: Hi, I'm interested in the incubator program. Can first-year students apply?
They can, but every team needs at least one member who has finished the entrepreneurship course.
Oh, my teammate took it last spring. So we're fine?
Yes. Just attach her course certificate to your application.

questions.explain: 女子最後說 Just attach her course certificate，即隊友的修課證明。其他選項（教授核可的計畫、新生證明、主任推薦信）對話中皆未要求。
options: A business plan approved by a professor
His teammate's course certificate
Proof that he is a first-year student
A letter from the incubator director
questions.prompt: What must the man submit with his application?

audio.t: Did you see the feedback from the mentor session?
Yeah. She liked our app idea, but she said our budget is unrealistic.
So we need to cut the marketing costs?
Actually, she thought we underestimated our server costs. We should raise that number.

questions.explain: 男子說 she thought we underestimated our server costs，問題在伺服器成本估太低。業師其實喜歡這個點子；刪減行銷費用是女子的猜測，被男子以 Actually 否定。
options: The team underestimated its server costs.
The app idea is not original.
The marketing budget is too high.
questions.prompt: What problem did the mentor point out?

audio.t: Attention, all teams in the Campus Startup Challenge. Because of scheduled power maintenance in the student center, tomorrow's demo day has been moved to Monday, November thirtieth. The time and room will stay the same. Teams that cannot attend on the new date should email the organizing committee by Friday, so that we can arrange an online presentation slot.

questions.explain: 廣播說無法出席新日期的隊伍 should email the organizing committee by Friday，以安排線上發表。明天的活動已延期；時間與教室不變；並未提到退賽。
options: Go to the student center tomorrow
Present in a different room
Email the organizing committee by Friday
Withdraw from the competition
questions.prompt: What should teams do if they cannot come on the new date?

audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the Innovation Incubator orientation. I'm David Lin, the program manager. Over the next six months, selected teams will receive free workspace on the third floor of the engineering building, a starting fund of fifty thousand dollars, and weekly meetings with a mentor from industry. Many students ask whether they need a finished product to join. You don't. What we look for is a clear problem, a team that works well together, and evidence that real users want your solution.

There are two things I strongly recommend before you apply. First, talk to at least twenty potential customers and write down what they tell you. Judges are far more impressed by real interviews than by beautiful slides. Second, decide early how your team will share ownership. Disagreements about that have broken up more promising teams than any technical problem. Applications close on December fifteenth, and interviews will take place in the first week of January.

questions.explain: 講者是育成計畫經理，介紹計畫提供的資源、選拔標準與申請建議，屬計畫說明會。投影片只是被拿來比較；未提租辦公室規則或去年成績。
options: Rules for renting office space on campus
How to design professional slides
The results of last year's competition
An introduction to a startup support program
questions.prompt: What is the talk mainly about?

questions.explain: 講者被問是否需要完成的產品時明確說 You don't。明確的問題與使用者需求的證據都是他們要找的條件。
options: A finished product
A clear problem to solve
Evidence that users want the solution
questions.prompt: According to the speaker, what is NOT required to join the program?

questions.explain: 講者建議先訪談至少二十位潛在顧客，並及早決定團隊持股分配。精美投影片反而被說不如真實訪談；五萬元與業師都是計畫提供的資源，不是申請前要做的事。
options: Interview at least twenty potential customers
Prepare attractive presentation slides
Agree on how ownership will be shared
Raise fifty thousand dollars
Find an industry mentor
questions.prompt: Which TWO things does the speaker recommend doing before applying? (Choose TWO.)

questions.explain: 業師指出計畫中幾個薄弱的假設後，團隊決定「修改」計畫，revise 最合理。reveal 揭露、resign 辭職、reserve 預訂，皆不合語意。
options: reveal
resign
revise
reserve
questions.prompt: Our team decided to ______ the business plan after the mentor pointed out several weak assumptions.

questions.explain: 已有五百多位活躍使用者，代表市場「需求」強，market demand 為固定搭配。supply 供給與句意相反；decision、permission 不與 market 搭配表達此意。
options: supply
demand
decision
permission
questions.prompt: The judges were impressed that the app had already attracted over five hundred active users, which showed strong market ______.

head: From: Office of Innovation and Entrepreneurship
To: Huang Jia-wei
Subject: Your Startup Challenge application
passage: Thank you for submitting your team's application for the Campus Startup Challenge. We have reviewed your materials, and your project, a mobile app that helps students share leftover cafeteria meals, has been selected for the second round.

Before the second round, each team must attend one of two pitch workshops, held on November 24 or November 26 from 6:30 to 8:30 p.m. in Room 205 of the Management Building. Please register for one session through the online form by Saturday. In addition, your current budget does not include the cost of food-safety certification. Please revise this section and upload the updated file by December 1.
We look forward to seeing your pitch. Feel free to contact us if you have any questions.

questions.explain: 信中通知團隊已進入第二輪（selected for the second round），並說明要參加工作坊、修改預算等後續步驟。並非拒絕通知，也與餐廳政策或擔任評審無關。
options: To announce a new cafeteria policy
To reject a team's application
To invite students to judge a competition
To tell a team that it has advanced and what to do next
questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?

questions.explain: 信中指出預算未包含食品安全認證費用，請他們 revise this section，即修改預算部分。其他項目信中皆未要求更改。
options: The name of their app
The time of their pitch
The budget section
The workshop location
questions.prompt: What does Ms. Wu ask the team to change?

questions.explain: has been selected for the second round 意為「被選入第二輪」，selected 與 chosen 同義。delayed 延後、ignored 忽略、copied 複製皆不符。
options: chosen
delayed
ignored
copied

passage: Five years ago, only a handful of students at our university showed any interest in starting a business. This year, the Campus Startup Challenge received 92 applications, a record number. According to the Office of Innovation and Entrepreneurship, the increase is partly due to a new entrepreneurship course, which became an elective open to all departments in 2024.

One of last year's winners, a team of three engineering and design students, developed a low-cost sensor that warns farmers when soil becomes too dry. After the competition, the team joined the campus incubator, where they received office space and advice from experienced mentors. Today, their product is being tested on twelve farms in Yunlin County. "We learned more from failing in front of real farmers than from any textbook," said team leader Lin Pei-shan.

However, not everyone is convinced that the trend is entirely positive. Professor Chang Wen-hao of the Department of Economics warns that some students spend so much time on their startups that their grades suffer. "A startup can be a great learning experience," he said, "but students should not forget that their degree is their safety net." He suggests that the university offer academic credit for incubator work, so that students do not have to choose between their projects and their studies.

The office says it is considering the idea. In the meantime, it plans to add evening workshops on finance and legal issues next semester, since many teams have said these are the areas where they feel least prepared.

questions.explain: 第一段說申請增加部分歸因於新的創業課程，自 2024 年起開放全校各系選修。辦公空間只提供給進入育成中心的團隊；文中未提獎金或經濟系施壓。
options: A larger cash prize for winners
Free office space for every student
A new entrepreneurship course open to all departments
Pressure from the Department of Economics
questions.prompt: What is one reason given for the rise in applications?

questions.explain: 產品正在雲林十二座農場測試，隊長也說從在農民面前失敗中學到更多，可推知他們透過實地測試改進產品。團隊成員來自工程與設計，且產品仍在進行中。
options: They have stopped working on their product.
They improved their product through real-world testing.
They are all students in the Department of Economics.
They won first place two years in a row.
questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the soil-sensor team?
